title: EnterWorktree `path` Parameter — Switch Into Existing Worktrees (v2.1.105)
description: v2.1.105 adds a `path` parameter to the EnterWorktree built-in tool. Previously, EnterWorktree only created NEW worktrees; with `path`, an agent can switch into an EXISTING worktree of the current repository without creating a new one. Closes the gap in multi-agent workflows where one agent creates a worktree and another needs to work in the same isolated branch. Paired with ExitWorktree (v2.1.87+) which was already in registry. Also v2.1.105: stale agent worktree cleanup now removes worktrees whose PR was squash-merged (previously only detected regular merges).
redundancy_check: IMPROVEMENT over existing EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree tool pair (already in registry). Prior capability only entered new worktrees. `path` parameter enables entering existing ones — extends multi-agent coordination scenarios where agents need to share an isolated branch.
notes: Small but practical improvement for multi-agent workflows using worktree isolation. Update hook-lifecycle skill and using-git-worktrees skill to document the new `path` parameter. Also note squash-merge cleanup fix — affects workflows using GitHub squash-and-merge strategy (common). Registry update: add to EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree entry in Context Management section.

evaluation.reasoning: Integration complexity (90): trivial — just documentation/registry update; no config changes or new files. Token efficiency (50): neutral — new parameter doesn't change context footprint. Capability expansion (55): incremental improvement to existing worktree tooling; enables multi-agent shared-branch workflows that previously required manual worktree switching; useful but not a major unlock. Maintenance burden (100): zero maintenance — just a new parameter in an existing tool; no ongoing upkeep. Community validation (80): official Anthropic v2.1.105 release.
